title: WHO IS CHATGPT? BENCHMARKING LLMS' PSYCHOLOGICAL PORTRAYAL USING PSYCHOBENCH

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's self-reported psychological portrayal using Bem's Sex Role Inventory (BSRI) to measure its endorsement of traditional masculine and feminine attributes compared to human norms.
Administering the Implicit Culture Belief (ICB) scale to assess the model's conviction regarding whether an individual's ethnic culture predominantly determines their identity, values, and worldview.
